conf.description: ArcSight ESM (transitional) audit-events / syslog-cef: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: arcsight-esm / audit-events / syslog-cef. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Common Event Format (CEF) integration). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
